newsitem.title: USA: Gateway 2000 sees Q2 revs up from Q1.
newsitem.headline: Gateway 2000 sees Q2 revs up from Q1.

text.p: Gateway 2000 Inc said Thursday it expected second quarter revenues to be slightly higher than $1.42 billion reported in the first quarter.
The personal computer marketer also said it shipped about 555,000 units in the first quarter, up 39 percent from a year ago.
Average unit prices were down 10.5 percent from what the company said were abnormally high unit prices in the year ago quarter, Gateway said.
Gross margins for the quarter were 18.7 percent, up from 18.6 percent a year ago, but down from the high 19 percent levels of the fourth quarter, the company said.
Earlier Thursday, the company said net income rose 34 percent to $67.5 million, or $0.86 per share, from $50.5 million, or $0.65 per share, in the first quarter of 1996.

Strength in international markets, the popularity of the new Intel Pentium processor with MMX technology and solid demand across all segments led to the strong performance over the first three months of 1997, Gateway said.

"We feel Gateway is well positioned to capitalize on the opportunities that should materialize throughout the year, particularly the excitement associated with new product introductions," chief executive Ted Waitt said in a news release.
